CREATE TABLE accounts (
    account_id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_holder VARCHAR(100),
    balance DECIMAL(10,2)
)

(2, 'Rohit', 3000.00)

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE transfer_money(
    p_from_account INT,
    p_to_account INT,
    p_amount DECIMAL
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    from_balance DECIMAL;
BEGIN
    -- Fetch balance
    SELECT balance INTO from_balance
    FROM accounts
    WHERE account_id = p_from_account;

    -- ❌ BUG 1: No NULL check (account may not exist)

    -- ❌ BUG 2: Wrong condition (should be < p_amount)
    IF from_balance <= p_amount THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'Insufficient balance';
    END IF;

    -- ❌ BUG 3: Deducting from WRONG account
    UPDATE accounts
    SET balance = balance - p_amount
    WHERE account_id = p_to_account;

    -- ❌ BUG 4: Adding money to WRONG account
    UPDATE accounts
    SET balance = balance + p_amount
    WHERE account_id = p_from_account;

    -- ❌ BUG 5: No transaction safety / rollback
END;
$$
